basic_details.job_title: NCDC Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online for 16 Technical Officer, data Manager and More Posts

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for NCDC Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 29-09-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

content_sections.heading: NCDC Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates should download and read the NCDC Jobs 2026 notification PDF carefully to check vacancy details, eligibility, age limit, and application instructions. The notification also includes important dates and selection process details. The direct download link is available in the Important Links section below. Download NCDC Job 2026 Employment Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: NCDC Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 16 vacancies are available - 2 for Senior Public Health Specialist, 3 for Public Health Specialist, 2 for Microbiologist, 1 for Training Manager, 1 for Technical Officer (Finance), 2 for Technical Officer (IT), 1 for Communication Specialist, 2 for Data Analyst, and 2 for Data Manager.

rows.event: Last Date for Submission of Application via Email

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for NCDC Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 29-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NCDC recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the NCDC Various Contractual Posts is 29th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in the NCDC recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 16 vacancies announced for various contractual posts at the National Centre for Disease Control (NCDC) under this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for NCDC recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this NCDC recruitment is via email. Candidates need to send their complete application along with required documents to the specified email address.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for NCDC recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this NCDC recruitment. The application is free of cost.

faq.question: Q5. What is the job type for these NCDC posts?
faq.answer: The posts announced under this NCDC recruitment are contractual in nature. This means the employment will be for a fixed tenure.

faq.question: Q6. Where is the NCDC located?
faq.answer: The National Centre for Disease Control (NCDC) is located in Delhi, with the specific address being Delhi, 110054.

faq.question: Q7. What are the selection stages for NCDC recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the NCDC recruitment typically involves Screening, followed by a Written Test, and finally an Interview for the shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q8. Can candidates from any state apply for NCDC jobs?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for posts located in Delhi. While candidates from any state can apply, they must be willing to relocate to Delhi if selected.

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this NCDC recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this NCDC recruitment is CBC 17129/11/0008/2627. It is important to refer to this number for any correspondence.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for NCDC recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification for NCDC recruitment can be found on the organization's official website, www.idsp.mohfw.gov.in. A direct link is usually provided in the 'Important Links' section of job portals.
